The '''Razor-tailed tiger''' was a [[Feline/Legends|feline]] predator native to the planet [[Yurb]], and was revered for its hunting skills. It made its home in the area known as the [[Dust Pits]], preying on the creatures that sought water in the planets arid landscape.
